system.ssh.title: Personal SSH connection
system.ssh.description: Read the current caller SSH grant and machine addresses. Same-host clients use local files; Admin enablement is separate.
system.ssh.returns: Connection · state, host, port, username, authentication, home, addresses
errors: Not enabled, unavailable or SSH management not configured.

system.users.title: User profiles
system.users.description: List registered user profiles available for ownership assignment.

components.assign_owner.title: Attribute shared software
components.assign_owner.description: Set the responsible user or built-in attribution for Loom-supplied software. Sharing, namespace, source revisions and Job pins remain unchanged.
components.assign_owner.returns: Attribution · kind, id, namespace, owner_profile, owner_kind, changed
errors: Unregistered user, missing extension, read-only scope or maintenance fence.

jobs.assign_owner.title: Assign Job owner
jobs.assign_owner.description: Set the current responsible user, preserving original execution and submitter records.
errors: Unregistered profile or missing Job.

results.assign_owner.title: Assign result owner
results.assign_owner.description: Set the current responsible user for a model, dataset or artifact.
errors: Unregistered profile or missing artifact.

jobs.queue.title: Shared execution order
jobs.queue.description: Read every user's waiting order and available controls.
jobs.queue.returns: Queue · revision, entries with position, held, reason, capabilities

jobs.reorder.title: Reorder waiting Job
jobs.reorder.description: Move a waiting Job ahead of other users' Jobs. Preserve running Jobs and dependencies.
errors: Permission denied, invalid position or reference no longer waiting. If execution was claimed first, changed=false.

jobs.hold.title: Hold waiting Job
jobs.hold.description: Prevent new stages of a waiting Job. Active preparation finishes, but run cannot start.
errors: Permission denied. If the main run already started, changed=false.

jobs.resume.title: Resume waiting Job
jobs.resume.description: Release an ordinary hold while preserving order. This is not error recovery or checkpoint restart.
errors: Permission denied. Releasing a failed Job's hold does not rerun its failed execution.

system.guide.title: Loom guides
system.guide.description: Read server version and guide index, or a document by id. Matching known_revision returns not_modified.
errors: Unknown document ID or invalid arguments.

jobs.list.title: List Jobs
jobs.list.description: List logical Jobs in reverse registration order. include_consolidated=true also returns preserved constituent Jobs.
jobs.list.returns: Job[] · id, status, state, owner, attempt, recovery, category, execution_mode

jobs.get.title: Job details
jobs.get.description: Read state, Attempts, internal_steps, consolidation provenance, work_timeline from original execution receipts, waiting reasons, recovery, callbacks and artifacts. Consolidated work elapsed time includes sources; Attempts retain continuation runtime timestamps.
jobs.get.returns: Job · status, scheduling, recovery, attempts, stages, callbacks, result
errors: The ID does not exist.

jobs.submit.title: Submit Job
jobs.submit.description: Pin a registered profile and parameters and enter the queue. category does not select the executor. One requested outcome is one Job; batch/vectorized work runs internally. Explicit consolidates reuses completed producer Jobs without rewriting them.
errors: Unregistered profile, parameter schema mismatch, denied input access or stopped admission.
Reusing a key with different execution content causes a conflict.

jobs.cancel.title: Cancel Job
jobs.cancel.description: Cancel the specified Job, regardless of owner. For active execution, verify actual resource return separately.
errors: Missing cancel scope.

jobs.logs.title: Execution logs
jobs.logs.description: Read Attempt logs using a byte cursor. Continue from next_offset.
jobs.logs.returns: Log range · available, offset, next_offset, text
errors: Attempt belongs to another Job, negative offset or limit outside 1–65536.

recovery.claim.title: Claim recovery
recovery.claim.description: Claim a failed Job awaiting a response. Pass the returned lease to progress/resume.
recovery.claim.returns: Recovery · state, rounds, agent, deadline, hard_deadline, lease
errors: Waiting deadline expired or another agent already claimed recovery.

recovery.progress.title: Report recovery progress
recovery.progress.description: Report progress with a valid lease to refresh the idle deadline, without extending the round's hard deadline.
recovery.progress.returns: Recovery · state, rounds, agent, deadline, hard_deadline
errors: Lease mismatch, claimant mismatch or expired recovery deadline.

recovery.resume.title: Rerun after repair
recovery.resume.description: Schedule recovery at the reserved queue position. patch permits only params/kind/execution.
errors: Lease mismatch, three recovery rounds exhausted or invalid patched inputs.
For finalization-only failure, retry postprocessing without a patch.

recovery.defer.title: Defer recovery
recovery.defer.description: Release the current queue reservation. Dependent Jobs wait while independent Jobs proceed.
errors: No valid reservation. Another user's reservation can be explicitly released; the acting user is recorded.

recovery.reactivate.title: Reactivate deferred Job
recovery.reactivate.description: Return a deferred Job to a new queue position without resetting recovery rounds.
errors: Job is not deferred.

events.list.title: Completion and error events
events.list.description: Read up to 100 unacknowledged recipient events in seq order. Use kind=all to include completion.
events.list.returns: Event[] · seq, job, code, kind, ack, delivery_state
errors: Unsupported kind or invalid cursor.

events.ack.title: Acknowledge event
events.ack.description: Record receipt of an event. This does not claim recovery or mark work complete.
errors: Event belongs to another recipient or seq does not exist.

components.list.title: List components
components.list.description: Read the latest revision of all components. Set owner to filter the namespace.
components.list.returns: Component[] · owner (namespace), id, revision, owner_profile, owner_name, owner_kind

components.get.title: Component details
components.get.description: Read an exact or latest Job lifecycle Component manifest and profiles.
components.get.returns: Component · owner (namespace), id, revision, manifest, profiles, owner_profile, owner_name, owner_kind
errors: Missing component or owner access denied.

components.write.title: Write source
components.write.description: Save editable source at a relative path. Active revisions remain unchanged.

example.content:
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
r = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[-1]).read_text())
o = Path(r["output_dir"])
(o/"sample.txt").write_text("hello")
p = {"profile": r["profile"]["revision"], "producer_sha256": r["profile"]["sha256"]}
(o/"result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"entities": [{"id": "sample", "kind": "artifact", "path": "sample.txt", "provenance": p, "relations": []}], "metrics": []}))

errors: Absolute path, parent-directory escape or owner access denied.

components.register.title: Register revision
components.register.description: Register source as an immutable revision. profiles is optional; standalone register_profile can reference the revision. New orchestration defaults to Rust; discover Cargo/SDK templates with components.scaffold. Registration never builds or executes source.
components.register.returns: Registration · owner (namespace), id, revision, profiles[], owner_profile, owner_name, owner_kind
errors: Missing source, unavailable runtime, missing GPU permission or profile contract mismatch.

components.register_profile.title: Register profile
components.register_profile.description: Register an execution Profile combining optional Component, exact Tools and stage environments. Optional multi-purpose usage is descriptive. Available without redeployment; Jobs pin the revision.
components.register_profile.returns: Profile receipt · owner, id, revision, kind, sha256
errors: Uncached image, resource limit exceeded, unregistered component or invalid schema.

components.get_profile.title: Profile details
components.get_profile.description: Read a specific or latest revision of an independently registered profile.
errors: Profile access denied or missing revision.

components.profiles.title: Available execution profiles
components.profiles.description: Read exact Profile combinations, stage environments and observed Job usage. Repeated environment dependencies are a bounded preview (dependency_count, dependencies_complete); use components.get_runtime for the complete inventory. Read scope does not grant execution or registration rights.
components.profiles.returns: Profile[] · kind, revision, params_schema, outputs, limits, usage, combination

results.list.title: List artifacts
results.list.description: Discover native artifacts and imported models/datasets/experiments from the active catalog. For record_type=historical, pass history_ref to results.historical; other entries use results.get. Discovery does not establish file availability.
results.list.returns: Artifact list · native registry entries or historical entries with history_ref and detail_action

results.get.title: Artifact details
results.get.description: Read an artifact record by ID and revision.
errors: Artifact access denied or missing revision.

results.reindex.title: Reindex results
results.reindex.description: Retry publication for a returned execution without restarting GPU execution. Published output identities, hashes, metadata and lineage must remain identical; use reconnect to add a verified location.
errors: Not the current Attempt or publication cannot be retried in this state.

results.reconnect.title: Reconnect artifact location
results.reconnect.description: Register a verified replacement location for an existing immutable artifact component. Does not rerun execution or change artifact contents.
results.reconnect.returns: Location receipt · id, revision, component, ref, status=available
errors: Requires submit scope; unknown store/component, unsafe path or mismatched size/hash is rejected.

results.annotate.title: Add annotation
results.annotate.description: Append evidence and a note without overwriting existing results.
errors: Requires submit scope.

results.history.title: Preserved history
results.history.description: Read all preserved records with pagination.
errors: Requires read scope.

results.historical.title: Historical record
results.historical.description: Read immutable history plus current registered-copy availability. Recorded missing does not prove the original was deleted.
results.historical.returns: Historical record · body, source identity and current_availability (not_connected, missing, verified, present_unverified, mismatch or unavailable)
errors: The specified record does not exist.

system.updates.title: Release check status
system.updates.description: Compare cached GitHub Releases with the current build. Reads do not wait on network requests or the Job database.
system.updates.returns: ReleaseCheck · status, installed, latest, update_available, checked_at, last_success_at, next_check_at, error, stale

system.check_updates.title: Check for releases
system.check_updates.description: Request a background check respecting the 60-second cooldown and GitHub rate limits. Does not install releases or stop Jobs.
errors: Failures appear in updates.error while preserving the last successful result.

system.status.title: Service status
system.status.description: Read build, contract revision, admission, registered runtimes and GPU execution availability.
system.status.returns: Status · build, api_revision, admission, inventory, runtime_ids, gpu_execution_enabled

system.docker.title: Container status
system.docker.description: Read permitted Docker containers and observation status.
system.docker.returns: Docker status · status, engine, containers, errors
errors: Missing or stale observations are reported through status and errors.

system.contract.title: Job contract
system.contract.description: Read Job properties, public states, recovery policy and submission schema.

system.describe.title: Action reference
system.describe.description: Without arguments, return the full usage reference. Supply both group/action to describe one action.
system.describe.returns: Documentation index or Action reference · schema, scope, returns, errors, examples
errors: Unknown action or action outside current scopes.

components.curate.title: Curate Runtimes workspace metadata
components.curate.description: Set a Profile display name, purpose, preferred/archive state or declared Tool stage roles; set representative dependencies on an exact Runtime. Does not rewrite execution definitions or select a Runtime.
errors: Submit scope, maintenance fence, exact identity, dependency scope or preference conflict.

components.inspect_profile.title: Inspect a reusable Profile
components.inspect_profile.description: Read stage Runtime evidence and scoped dependency requirements; optionally validate parameters. Does not reserve resources, install, import code or submit a Job.
components.inspect_profile.returns: Inspection, parameter validation and partial submission draft
errors: Unknown Profile or invalid inspection arguments.

components.compare_profiles.title: Compare exact Profile definitions
components.compare_profiles.description: Compare source, stage, Tool/Runtime, parameter and output contracts. Returns changed paths without environment variable values. Display-only changes do not count as execution changes.
errors: Unknown Profile.

components.annotate.title: Classify software
components.annotate.description: Attach evidence-backed revision tags and a concise label without changing source, digests, Profiles or Jobs.

example.evidence: Verified planner interface in this revision.

errors: Missing revision, invalid tag, submit scope denied or maintenance fence.

components.runtimes.title: List Runtimes
components.runtimes.description: Read administrator-granted execution environments, exact dependencies, validation evidence and Profile/Job usage. Legacy entries are not verification evidence.

components.dependencies.title: Dependencies
components.dependencies.description: Read major software units grouped across current granted Runtimes, with exact versions, distinct installation origins and Runtime links. Full transitive package inventories remain on each Runtime. This is recorded metadata, not filesystem discovery or proof of scientific use.

components.get_dependency.title: Dependency versions
components.get_dependency.description: Read all recorded versions and origins of one dependency across granted Runtime revisions, including history.
errors: Dependency unavailable or outside instance grant.

components.get_runtime.title: Runtime revision
components.get_runtime.description: Read one exact immutable Runtime revision and its consumers. Installation/build is an explicit host-administrator workflow.
errors: Missing revision or instance grant.

components.list_tools.title: List research Tools
components.list_tools.description: List shared reusable software independently of Job Components.

components.get_tool.title: Tool revision
components.get_tool.description: Read an exact or latest immutable software revision.
errors: Missing Tool revision.

components.register_tool.title: Register research Tool
components.register_tool.description: Register source or explicitly copy an exact legacy Component revision; existing Jobs and revisions remain unchanged. New orchestration defaults to Rust; discover Cargo/SDK templates with components.scaffold. Registration never builds or executes source.
errors: Invalid source, missing legacy revision or denied submit scope.

jobs.submit_workflow.title: Submit one logical Job
jobs.submit_workflow.description: Atomically submit pinned internal execution nodes with node dependencies and output aliases. Each node uses the ordinary scheduler and verified artifacts. Replay the exact request key after an uncertain response.
jobs.submit_workflow.returns: Logical Job ID and node execution IDs
errors: Unknown/cyclic node dependency, conflicting key, invalid Profile or output alias. All nodes roll back on rejection.

jobs.curate.title: Curate research presentation
jobs.curate.description: Preview or apply additive, evidence-backed presentation bindings. Original execution, timestamps, results and software revisions remain intact. Omit dry_run for a preview; false applies the exact batch once.
errors: Unknown identity, repeated item, parent cycle, conflicting batch key, maintenance or scope denied.
